mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 4.5% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in <60% of FEDFUNDS <4.5% periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 2-year window during easing phases.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 2.5% signals labor market tightening, reducing risk premiums and driving up equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) during UNRATE <2.5% periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) and decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) creates a synergistic effect, amplifying equity valuation growth and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases by 2% AND FEDFUNDS decreases by 1% in the same month
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p>0.05) or 60d returns not higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals over-supply and weakening growth, leading to short-term negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly negative (t-test p >0.05) during INDPRO declines in late-cycle periods, or Rank IC >0.03 over any 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 5.5% signals monetary tightening, raising recession risk and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns not significantly negative (p>0.05) during FEDFUNDS >5.5% periods, or Rank IC >0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 2% indicates a robust labor market, reducing risk premiums and driving up equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 1% AND UNRATE falls below 2%
failure_condition: Interaction effect not statistically significant (p>0.05) or 20d returns not higher than baseline (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production index (INDPRO) above 105 signals robust supply-side growth, reducing inflationary pressures and fostering equity valuation appreciation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) during INDPRO >105 periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery phase, when GDP demand (GDPC1) exceeds its 3-month rolling average by 2%, it signals a resumption of growth momentum, driving up equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly positive (t-test p >0.05) during GDPC1 above-trend periods, or Rank IC <0.03 over any 1-year window.
